notes:
Coverage notes (part 2: eps_part2.jsonl, 327 rows, MU seasons 14-23, Dec 2016 - Apr 2020).
- Pairs already in current_mu_links.json were not repeated: 19.05 Welsh Triangle cases, 17.05 Dodleston, 17.10 Martin Tower bear, 18.10 Solway spaceman, 22.18 Black Monk, 21.12 Everton Spring-heeled Jack, 21.18 Cannock Chase, plus loch-ness theme links (16.09, 17.01 Plus, 18.22, 21.08 Plus, 23.07).
- new_cases with more than one episode carry an 'extra_episodes' array (episode_id, url, excerpt). Each extra should become an extra covered_in link once the case is created.
- Many MU articles cited in the notes (mysteriousuniverse.org/2015-2019) are paywalled, and BBC / derbytelegraph / nypost / edp24 pages were blocked, so several items stay themes or notes:
  * 15.22 Plus 'YORKSHIRE ALIEN ABDUCTION' (BBC Inside Out Yorks & Lincs series 1) could not be opened. It may be Alan Godfrey / Todmorden but is unconfirmed, so no link was made.
  * 16.09 Plus 'A Ghostly Airman At Loch Ness?' (phantom bomber): the Wellington R-Robert ditched in Loch Ness on 31 Dec 1940, but no ghost account could be verified. Already linked as loch-ness theme.
  * 18.11 'Haunted by a Phantom Ape' (MU 2017/09) could not be placed (paywall). Filed under the elliott-odonnell theme only.
  * 16.07 Plus mentions 'interdimensional volcano areas in the UK' but no UK link or place, so skipped.
  * 16.11 Plus 'The Bellings Town Fairy' book: location unknown, skipped.
  * 21.17 Plus Isle of Man WWII event: no place found (The Alien Gene book). Kept as a theme.
- Portals of London items (Woolwich Foot Tunnel, Hornsey Town Hall, Crystal Palace Stardoor) come from a blog the author describes as part psychogeography / ghost story. Treat them as folklore-grade.
- Skipped as not paranormal or not a UK case: 16.11 Saltburn hotel food poisoning, 18.24 Wolverhampton microwave man, 16.25 London man bursting into flames (Dec 2017 news), 20.25 Irish woman's 'ghost pirate' marriage, 20.25 Thames skeleton, 20.12 Menwith Hill/Echelon link (surveillance, not paranormal), 21.07 Plus R101 airship crash (France), 21.16 SAGB/Mavis Pittilla (no case), 18.16 Plus 'Great British Eccentrics', 17.11 Titanic conspiracy, 17.12 sweating sickness.
- Coordinates marked approx in desc where only area-level. Kerry pilots' sighting is offshore airspace.
